rationale: Despite the stock being in a heavy sell-off at the bottom 3% of its intraday range ($72.61 vs $72.25 low) well below VWAP ($76.75) and the 5m 9-EMA ($73.12), shorting right at the session lows after a nearly 29% drop from the prior close carries severe exhaustion and bounce risk. Conversely, there is zero structural evidence of a reversal to justify a long entry, as the last four 1-minute candles show lower highs and lower closes. Combined with a wide 16.5 bps spread and five existing active/working portfolio positions, passing is the optimal risk-adjusted choice.
